title: Thailand-Cambodia Border War Tracker Update — Thu Aug 27, 2026
summary: PM Anutin Charnvirakul's August 23 visit to Thai troops at the disputed Hill 500/Chong An Ma crossing drew a formal Cambodian protest on August 25, with Phnom Penh Post commentary urging an arrest warrant against him. Anutin dismissed the calls on August 27, saying he acted lawfully under the December 2025 Joint Statement. Cambodia calls the site An Seh and maintains it has been under illegal Thai occupation since 2025. Added a new contested map point/line at the site and a claims entry on the sovereignty dispute.
